snapshot.text: Serbia is modernising its health system, with heavy investment in emergency care buildings, equipment and ambulances. Out-of-pocket spending is 32.1% of health spending (2023). EU funding from 2026 targets cardiovascular disease, cancer and youth mental health.

priorities.title: Emergency care and infrastructure investment
priorities.text: The government is putting money into health buildings and equipment, including a new Belgrade emergency medicine institute and a modern call centre.

priorities.title: EU4Health funding access
priorities.text: Under a December 2025 agreement, Serbian public and private health bodies can seek EU money from January 2026 for treatment, digital health and critical medicines.
